tools.name: preopen_audit
tools.description: Pre-open audit of a received tree ($0.99 after the one-time free trial, or plan-included). Args: tree {files:[{path,content|content_b64|link}]}, harness, version, policy.

tools.name: lookup_verdict
tools.description: Precomputed signed verdict for one tree_hash x harness x version ($0.01; free inside plans). Args: tree_hash, harness, version.

tools.name: sanitise_tree
tools.description: Audit + sanitised quarantined copy ($1.99, always metered). Args: tree, harness, version, policy.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an Ed25519-signed receipt (free). Args: signed_verdict.
